name: Sterilization
overview: Scripture reveals that God created humanity in His image as male and female, establishing the foundation for human life and procreation (Genesis 1:27). Following the flood, God specifically commanded Noah and his descendants to be fruitful and multiply, emphasizing the importance of reproduction in His design (Genesis 9:1, 9:7). Deuteronomy 23:1 further underscores the seriousness with which God regards physical wholeness related to reproductive capacity, indicating that those who have been physically maimed in their reproductive organs are excluded from full participation in the congregation of the LORD. Together, these passages affirm the biblical principle that human fertility and the ability to bear children are integral to God's purpose for mankind.
